name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun saw a sharp pullback over the last 7 days, with leads dropping 41.3% and spend falling 33.72% period-over-period, driven largely by a 47.53% reduction in Google Ads spend that produced zero conversions over the full 28-day window. With Meta carrying all 133 leads at a CPL of $19.24, pausing or scaling back Google Ads appears to be the primary lever behind both the cost reduction and the lead volume decline.

performance.verdict: Google's $1,145 spend over 28 days produced zero leads — Meta is funding everything.

findings.text: SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due Jul 20) shows no completed verification event — money paths unconfirmed.
Google Ads consumed $1,144.71 over 28 days with 0 conversions and 178 clicks — confirmed dead channel for lead generation.
Meta CPL rose 12.92% week-over-week; 3-day signal (Aug 16–18: 2+7 leads, $4.96+$32.78+$148.68 spend) shows uneven daily delivery suggesting budget irregularity, not fatigue.
GHL shows 133 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments — leads arriving but pipeline is stalled, intake or follow-up is leaking, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 40% week-over-week to near-zero (0 actions Aug 16–18); organic brand signal collapsing alongside paid pullback.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads entirely — $1,144.71 spent over 28 days, 0 leads, 0 conversions confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $1,144.71 over the past 28 days with zero conversions and zero leads recorded. Pause all Google campaigns immediately to stop the confirmed spend leak. Success is confirmed when zero further Google spend accrues and the freed budget is available for reallocation. Re-evaluate Google reentry only after conversion tracking is verified client-side. Review by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Shift up to $15/day from paused Google budget into Meta — protect CPL ceiling while volume rebuilds.
suggestions.monday_update: With Google paused, redirect up to $15/day of the freed Google spend into the active Meta campaigns. Meta is currently the sole lead source at a CPL of $19.24, up 12.92% week-over-week — a modest budget increase should recover lead volume without compounding CPL risk. Confirm success if Meta leads return to 7+ per active day and CPL stabilises or declines by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 133 leads created, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm intake automation is firing correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 133 opportunities created over 28 days with zero appointments booked and zero won — leads are entering but nothing is progressing. Ahmed/Ali to audit the post-lead automation sequence: confirm assignment rules, follow-up triggers, and that the Becklar/BWS intake paths are routing correctly per the Aug gap-closure build. Success is at least one appointment booked within 48 hours of a new lead arriving. Report findings by 2026-08-22.
